scope: Software only; no hardware USB, multiboot electrical timing, or full-game certification

graphics.scope: Repeatable movement/menu sequence from local save; not all battles/scanline effects

timing.scope: Static field in mGBA; not physical performance

moving_timing.scope: Held directional input in mGBA; VBlank counts do not prove gameplay or audio smoothness

limitations: Timing is emulator-only. Feedback GPIO electrical path is not hardware validated.
90 exact graphics comparisons use coherent snapshots, not the sliced resident wire stream.
Selective observer enabled only for the verified overworld callback; other contexts use full scanning.
Per-resource transactional recovery, scanline effects and native UVC renderer are not implemented.
